title: build(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0 -> 10.12.1 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. eslint-plugin-vue is a lint-only devDependency; it can change diagnostics and autofix output but nothing that ships. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid.
behavior_change: None measured on this repository. Full-tree lint A/B on the merged tree (main 99a58807 + this bump; lint/build A/B run on main 53a86f0b + this bump, before #490 axios 1.21.1 merged — #490 changes no lint input (only axios and Python CI tests) and the plugin is not in the build), same install, plugin swapped with npm i --no-save eslint-plugin-vue@10.12.0 postcss-selector-parser@7.1.6 cssesc@3.0.0: 10.12.0 -> 34 errors / 6967 warnings; 10.12.1 -> 34 errors / 6967 warnings; 0 diagnostics added, 0 removed (compared as file+line+column+rule+severity+message multisets); 0 per-rule count changes. Autofix A/B (eslint --fix-dry-run, whole tree): 156 files receive autofix output under both versions and every output is byte-identical (0 files differ). Positive control proving the autofix A/B can see this release: on a crafted template `<my-comp foo=bar></my-comp>` with only vue/html-self-closing enabled, 10.12.0 produces `<my-comp foo=bar/>` (the slash joins the unquoted attribute value) and 10.12.1 produces `<my-comp foo=bar />` (10.12.1 #3159); the repository has no element where that difference arises. The other 10.12.1 changes (v-on-handler-style suggest-not-fix, component-name-in-template-casing namespaced tags, no-deprecated-slot-attribute v-bind:slot, no-undef-components self-reference, no-undef-properties Pinia map* helpers, no-unused-properties, no-useless-mustaches autofix, prefer-separate-static-class .attr/.prop, require-explicit-emits defineModel, require-explicit-slots crash) produce no diagnostic or autofix difference here, per the A/B. Production build: vite build under both versions -> 199/199 dist files byte-identical. postcss-selector-parser's only dependent is eslint-plugin-vue, and cssesc's only dependent was postcss-selector-parser, so neither reaches the build. Lint ratchet PASSES (errors 34/34, warnings 6967/6971). The 4-warning headroom is NOT from this bump (10.12.0 also gives 6967 on this tree); per the owner ruling the ceiling is not lowered inside a dependency PR.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares eslint-plugin-vue ^10.12.1 (was ^10.12.0). packages/client/package-lock.json (406 -> 405 entries) vs origin/main 99a58807: root devDependency range; eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0 -> 10.12.1; postcss-selector-parser 7.1.6 -> 7.2.1 (FORCED: 10.12.1 raises its floor to ^7.1.7; 7.2.1 is npm's resolution of that range); cssesc 3.0.0 REMOVED (postcss-selector-parser 7.2.x no longer depends on it and nothing else does). No other entry differs.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #493 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No source file, no ESLint config, no lint or type-check ceiling. Tailwind 4.3.5 (#491), supabase-js 2.119.0 (#492) and axios 1.21.1 (#490) entries are exactly as on main. Lockfile `peer` flags stay as on main (Dependabot flipped 16; dropped per main's convention since ec88eedd). Production dist byte-identical.
